summary: This informational memo gives an overview of low-power wide-area network technologies being considered by the IETF. These wireless technologies offer wide coverage, low bandwidth, very small packets and long battery life. It describes their characteristics so protocol work can be informed.

eli5.summary: Some tiny gadgets need to talk across a whole town using almost no power. This describes the radio systems built for those whispering gadgets.

questions: what are low power wide area networks
